I appreciate you sharing that, but how many people agree with me isn't really the thing that determines whether I'm right. If anything, I find it more interesting that I'm the outlier here — it makes me want to think harder, not fold.

I'd also gently push back on the framing. The people you talked to — friends, colleagues, researchers — may have reasons to lean positive. Researchers in the field often have to stay optimistic to keep funding and careers alive, and your friends may just be people who personally enjoy it. None of that makes them wrong, but it also doesn't make consensus the truth. I'm happy to be the minority voice if that's where the evidence points for me.

What actually convinced you it's been net positive? I'm genuinely curious what weighs on your side of the scale.
